verdict.rationale: xAI explicitly documents REST API compatibility with the OpenAI REST API, meaning existing OpenAI-compatible tooling can point at the xAI endpoint, and separate docs cover migration guides for deprecated models and third-party enterprise adapters (Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry) that also advertise OpenAI-compatible interfaces. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that a specific OpenAI SDK works unmodified against the xAI endpoint beyond vendor docs.
